As Intel Com (INTC) Valuation Rose, Argi Investment Services Trimmed Holding by $1.09 Million; Cobblestone Capital Advisors Increases Holding in Apple (AAPL)
May 19, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.84% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc bought 3,157 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 85,368 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.45M, up from 82,211 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $915.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $186.31. About 16.17M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Argi Investment Services Llc decreased its stake in Intel Corp Com (INTC) by 42.75% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Argi Investment Services Llc sold 23,640 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 31,657 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.46 million, down from 55,297 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Argi Investment Services Llc who had been investing in Intel Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $249.31 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.39% or $1.31 during the last trading session, reaching $53.5. About 21.27M shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 44.65% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.
